V01.answer: The most relevant source on neighbourhood life is a customary rule of Desa Adat Canggu: Awig-Awig Desa Adat Canggu (naskah 2012) - terjemahan Bahasa Indonesia tidak resmi (Pasal 4). It is written in Indonesian; the relevant passage is quoted below in its original wording.
recommended_actions: Before acting on a customary rule, confirm the current practice with your host or the kelian banjar (head of the neighbourhood).

quote.text: … (2) Di luar itu disebut tamiu. Menurut kedudukannya, ketentuannya dibedakan sebagai berikut: 1. Tamiu yang beragama Hindu, apabila: a. Mengunjungi keluarga di Desa Adat Canggu untuk bertamu dan bersembahyang di kahyangan desa. b. Mencari penghidupan dan bertempat tinggal sampai sebulan, wajib: • Dalam satu wuku (tujuh hari), melapor kepada prajuru adat dan dinas dengan dokumen yang jelas. • Membayar sadana krama (iuran kependudukan/keanggotaan) menurut ketentuan masing-masing banjar. • Didaftarkan menjadi krama banjar/desa menurut ketentuan masing-masing banjar. • Mereka yang diterima sebagai krama banjar/desa dikenai batu-batu (pungutan penerimaan anggota) menurut pararem. 2. Tamiu yang bukan beragama Hindu, apabila: a. Bertamu atau mencari penghidupan, wajib melapor kepada prajuru dinas dalam satu wuku dan membayar sadana krama setiap bulan menurut ketentuan masing-masing banjar dinas. b. Orang tersebut dikenai kewajiban ayah suka-duka adat.

V03.answer: The most relevant source on the environment and waste is a customary rule of Desa Adat Canggu: Pararem Desa Adat Canggu Nomor 3 Tahun 2025 tentang Pengelolaan Sampah di Wewidangan Desa Adat Canggu (Pasal 6). It is written in Indonesian; the relevant passage is quoted below in its original wording.
recommended_actions: Before acting on a customary rule, confirm the current practice with your host or the kelian banjar (head of the neighbourhood).

quote.text:
Pasal 6 Pengelolaan Sampah Rumah Tangga
(1) Setiap Krama Adat, Krama Tamiu, dan Tamiu dalam rumah tangga wajib melakukan pengelolaan sampah yang dihasilkannya.
(2) Pengelolaan sampah rumah tangga sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilakukan dengan cara: a. menggunakan barang dan/atau kemasan yang dapat didaur ulang dan mudah terurai oleh proses alam; b. membatasi timbulan sampah dengan tidak menggunakan plastik sekali pakai; c. menyediakan 5 (lima) jenis tempat penyimpanan sampah yang layak untuk menyimpan sampah terpilah berdasarkan jenisnya; d. melakukan pemilahan dan pewadahan sampah berdasarkan jenisnya; e. menyerahkan sampah jenis an-organik yang memiliki nilai jual ke unit pengelola sampah bersama dan/atau ke pengurus sekaa resik di tiap banjar adat sesuai dengan jadwal yang telah ditentukan; f. menempatkan sampah jenis an-organik yang tidak memiliki nilai jual dan sampah residu pada tempatnya, yang selanjutnya akan diambil oleh petugas unit pengelola sampah bersama tingkat desa.

quote.text:
Pasal 62 (Pawos 62) (1) Pelaksanaan Hari Nyepi mengikuti catur brata: 1. Amati geni: tidak boleh menyalakan api, kecuali: a. Bagi yang mempunyai bayi belum berusia tiga bulan, di tempat bayi tersebut. b. Bagi yang merawat orang sakit, di tempat orang sakit tersebut.
c. Bagi yang mempunyai jenazah, di tempat jenazah tersebut. 2. Amati karya: tidak boleh bekerja. 3. Amati lampah: tidak boleh bepergian, kecuali petilik desa dan prajuru dinas, serta mereka yang memperoleh izin dengan surat yang jelas. 4. Amati lelanguan: tidak boleh membuat suara keras, bersenang-senang/bermain, dan kegiatan sejenis.
(2) Pelanggar brata Nyepi dikenai sanksi menurut pararem, dilaksanakan oleh petilik desa dan Hansip. Denda dibagi tiga, masing-masing untuk desa, banjar, dan petilik/Hansip.
(3) Hari setelah Nyepi disebut Ngembak Geni, yang berarti berakhirnya yoga semadi, disertai saling memaafkan antar-krama desa/banjar sebagai tanda awal Tahun Saka.

V08.answer: Visitor etiquette at Balinese sacred places consists of respectful behavior toward religious spaces, worshippers, ceremonies, and local instructions. A Denpasar Tourism Office page reproducing the Bali provincial government's 2023 foreign-tourist guidance asks visitors to respect local religion and sacred places, respect traditional ceremonies, dress appropriately, and behave properly in sacred places.
V08.why_it_matters: Temples and sacred spaces are active religious environments. Visitor behavior should prioritize worshippers and the instructions of the temple or local authority.
recommended_actions: Follow signs and instructions from temple staff or local guides
Dress modestly and use required temple attire where applicable
Ask permission before photographing people, especially during ceremonies
Avoid: assume every temple has identical visitor access rules
Avoid: enter restricted areas without permission

V09.answer: Sumber yang paling relevan tentang tempat suci adalah peraturan pemerintah: PERATURAN GUBERNUR BALI NOMOR 25 TAHUN 2020 TENTANG PASILITASI PELINDUNGAN PURA, PRATIMA, DAN SIMBOL KEAGAMAAN (Pasal 13). Bagian yang relevan dikutip di bawah.

quote.text:
Pasal 13
(1) Pemeliharaan Pura dilakukan untuk mencegah Cuntaka atau Sebel, kerusakan, alih fungsi, dan/atau musnahnya Pura.
(2) Pemeliharaan Pura sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), dilakukan dengan cara: a. mencegah Cuntaka/Sebel; b. menjaga nilai kesucian Pura; c. menggunakan Tri Mandala Pura sesuai fungsi keagamaan, pendidikan, dan sosial budaya. d. menjaga keanekaragaman arsitektur Pura; e. menjaga lingkungan Pura yang bersih, sehat, hijau, dan indah; dan f. menggunakan sarana dan prasarana yang tidak berasal dari plastik sekali pakai.
(3) Cuntaka atau Sebel dicegah dengan cara: a. melarang setiap orang yang dalam keadaan Cuntaka atau Sebel memasuki Pura; b. melarang setiap orang yang tidak berhubungan langsung dengan suatu upacara, persembahyangan, piodalan dan/atau kegiatan Pelindungan Pura memasuki Pura; dan
c. memasang papan pengumuman mengenai larangan sebagaimana dimaksud pada huruf a dan huruf b.

V10.answer: Canang Sari is an offering used in daily worship by Balinese Hindus. A local government cultural article describes it as a small but essential element in offerings and yadnya. The Buleleng Culture and Tourism Office article explains Canang Sari as an expression associated with prayer and a request for Widya (knowledge) before Sang Hyang Widhi Wasa. It also describes symbolic elements such as the ceper and porosan.
V10.why_it_matters: It is part of everyday devotional practice and should not be treated merely as decoration or litter.
recommended_actions: Notice offerings and walk around them where practical
Ask a local host or guide if unsure what an offering is or where it has been placed
Avoid: deliberately step on, move, kick, or disturb an offering
Avoid: assume every offering has the same form or meaning

V11.answer: Galungan and Kuningan are important celebrations in Balinese Hindu religious life. An academic article indexed by Garuda describes the Galungan-Kuningan ritual as associated with devotion to God and the victory of dharma (goodness) over adharma (evil). The cited article compares Galungan-Kuningan with Navratri and discusses similarities and differences. The entry uses only the broad meaning stated in the article abstract and does not attempt to explain every ritual sequence.

V12.answer: Guidance for enjoying bars, clubs, beach clubs, restaurants, and evening events while respecting nearby residents and customary community life. Canggu has experienced documented community concern about noise from nightlife venues. In September 2022, Badung Tourism Office reported a coordination meeting where outdoor music volume was agreed to be limited to 70 dB and operating hours were to be arranged to avoid disturbing visitors staying nearby. Local reporting also described separate village-level discussions and agreements. These sources show a local noise-management issue, but they should not be treated as proof of one universally current closing time or a single rule applying to every venue today.
V12.why_it_matters: Nightlife businesses and visitors share space with residents, workers, temples, and everyday neighborhood activities. Respecting noise and access helps reduce conflict and supports sustainable tourism.
recommended_actions: Keep voices and music low when leaving venues or returning through residential streets
Respect venue notices, local signs, and instructions from staff or authorized officers
Use transport responsibly and avoid blocking narrow neighborhood roads
Avoid: do not assume that every venue has the same operating hours
Avoid: do not treat the 2022 noise-management agreement as a guaranteed current closing-time rule for every venue

H05.answer: Drivers should use the correct side of the road, signal and maneuver carefully, avoid obstructing traffic, respect pedestrians and cyclists, and respond responsibly after accidents. Kejati Bali's foreigner legal FAQ summarizes left-side driving, signaling before turns, avoiding mobile phone use, and respecting pedestrian and traffic rules. The 2025 Governor Circular requires compliance with Indonesian traffic regulations and signs.
H05.why_it_matters: Predictable driving and consideration for vulnerable road users reduce conflict, especially on narrow or crowded roads.
recommended_actions: Drive on the left
Signal before turning or changing direction
Park only where permitted and do not block traffic or pedestrian paths
Avoid: drive against traffic
Avoid: park where restricted or obstructive

H06.answer: Road users must obey signs and directions, use required safety equipment, respect passenger limits, and avoid impaired or distracted driving. The 2025 circular requires valid licences, compliance with traffic rules, helmets, obedience to signs, passenger limits, and no driving under the influence of alcohol or illegal drugs. Bali Police have highlighted helmet and seatbelt use, phone use while driving, wrong-way driving, underage riding, and overloading as enforcement concerns.
H06.why_it_matters: Road safety protects drivers, passengers, pedestrians, cyclists, and other road users.
recommended_actions: Wear a properly fastened motorcycle helmet
Use seat belts
Follow signs, signals, and police directions
Avoid: ride without a helmet
Avoid: use a mobile phone while driving

H07.answer: Sumber yang paling relevan tentang perilaku di tempat umum adalah panduan umum yang disusun dari sumber publik: Respectful Appearance and Photography. Sumber ini berbahasa Inggris; bagian yang relevan dikutip di bawah dalam bahasa aslinya.

quote.text: Visitors should dress appropriately for the setting and avoid photography or public behavior that disrespects people, ceremonies, sacred places, or religious symbols. The 2025 Governor Circular asks foreign tourists to dress modestly and respectfully in sacred areas, attractions, public places, and activities in Bali. It prohibits indecent or inappropriate photographs, including nudity, when these desecrate sacred places, temples, sacred objects, or religious symbols.

H08.answer: Tri Hita Karana is a Balinese philosophical framework commonly explained through three relationships that support well-being and harmony: Parahyangan (relationship between humans and the divine), Pawongan (relationships among people), and Palemahan (relationship between humans and the environment). The framework is used in discussions of Balinese social, spiritual, and environmental life. Government planning materials and cultural publications describe the three dimensions as interconnected rather than isolated categories.
H08.why_it_matters: It provides a useful introductory lens for understanding why spiritual spaces, community relationships, and care for the environment can be connected in Balinese cultural contexts.
recommended_actions: Treat the three dimensions as a broad interpretive framework, not as a complete explanation of every local practice
Ask local guides or community representatives how the concept is understood in the specific place you are visiting
Avoid: assume every Balinese person or village interprets or applies the concept identically
Avoid: reduce the concept to a simple tourist slogan or a rigid three-part checklist

H11.answer: Sumber yang paling relevan tentang kehidupan bertetangga adalah aturan adat Desa Adat Canggu: Awig-Awig Desa Adat Canggu (naskah 2012) - terjemahan Bahasa Indonesia tidak resmi (Pasal 4). Bagian yang relevan dikutip di bawah.
recommended_actions: Sebelum bertindak berdasarkan aturan adat, konfirmasikan praktik yang berlaku saat ini kepada pemilik akomodasi atau kelian banjar.

quote.text: Pasal 4 (Pawos 4) (1) Yang disebut krama desa ialah keluarga beragama Hindu yang menempati pekarangan sendiri dalam satu kesatuan pekarangan (apalebahan), atau krama yang bertempat tinggal tetap di wilayah Desa Adat Canggu, serta menaati isi awig-awig Desa Adat Canggu. (2) Di luar itu disebut tamiu. Menurut kedudukannya, ketentuannya dibedakan sebagai berikut: 1. Tamiu yang beragama Hindu, apabila: a. Mengunjungi keluarga di Desa Adat Canggu untuk bertamu dan bersembahyang di kahyangan desa. b. Mencari penghidupan dan bertempat tinggal sampai sebulan, wajib: • Dalam satu wuku (tujuh hari), melapor kepada prajuru adat dan dinas dengan dokumen yang jelas. • Membayar sadana krama (iuran kependudukan/keanggotaan) menurut ketentuan masing-masing banjar. • Didaftarkan menjadi krama banjar/desa menurut ketentuan masing-masing banjar. …
